summary: Outputs separate left/right eye textures to an Oculus Rift device after applying device-calibrated distortion.

key_params.name: active
key_params.note: Output image data to the device.

key_params.name: debugperfhud
key_params.note: Show off, latency, or render debug HUD in the headset.

common_gotchas: Official docs mark Oculus Rift TOP as Windows-only.
Requires two input textures, one for each eye.
Input imagery should already be rendered for left and right eye views before device distortion is applied.
Debug HUD is useful for latency/render timing checks but should be disabled for final viewing.
key_concepts: Connects to an Oculus Rift device and outputs headset imagery.
Applies distortion based on the device calibration parameters.
Uses separate input textures for each eye.
Debug HUD modes expose latency or render timing while testing headset output.
